title: Random Server Button
description: A button that sends you to a random server
body:
This is a random server button by AnyServer.pro

When you go to direct connect it will show the option for a random Minecraft server to connect to and will autofill it

It is powered by https://anyserver.pro meaning that you don't even need a mod to use it. But this is more convenient

Currently it doesn't have that many servers but the count is expected to grow quickly and if you would like your own to be on here just add it at https://anyserver.pro
